fixes.value: Flow chart for discovered or damaged materials that could contain asbestos. In both cases stop work immediately. For discovered materials: keep everyone else out of the area, report the problem to the person in charge as soon as possible and put up a 'Possible asbestos contamination' sign; then either have a sample analysed or presume it contains the worst type of asbestos; if it does, apply the appropriate controls using a licensed contractor if required, and update the asbestos management plan; if not, no action is required. For damaged materials, check for dust or debris on clothing: a little (sleeves, shoes) is wiped down with damp rags; a lot means stay put, avoid inhaling dust, put on RPE if possible, damp wipe and remove outer clothing, seek help (the helper wears PPE and RPE), damp wipe all contaminated items until visually clean, decide whether to wash hair and shower, and bag contaminated clothes and towels as asbestos waste. Finally dispose of rags as asbestos waste, keep a record and decide if the work needs a licensed contractor.
